description: This file defines a custom view class for the 'edit' view of Opportunities in SuiteCRM, overriding default behavior to inject custom JavaScript for handling sales probability based on sales stage. It includes class definition, constructor, and display method to add custom scripts to the view.

classes.name: OpportunitiesViewEdit
classes.description: Custom view class for editing opporunities, extending ViewEdit, used to override default behavior for specific customizations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the view and sets useForSubpanel to true.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overridden display method that injects a JavaScript snippet to dynamically update the 'probability' field based on 'sales_stage' selection, and then calls parent display method.
